description: TO_DATE over a nullable operand is nullable -- the operand was previously ignored entirely

columns.name: parsed
columns.note: raw_date is nullable, so TO_DATE(raw_date, ...) is nullable

name: to_date_nullable_operand
query_sql:
-- @name GetParsedDate
-- @returns :many
SELECT TO_DATE(raw_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS parsed FROM imports
schema_sql: CREATE TABLE imports (id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY, raw_date TEXT)
